summary: The tenso account opposes slowing AI, backs open weights, sees politics rather than AI as the danger and worries machines outnumber people online.

statements.quote: if frontier labs really want to save humanity and make sure AI doesn't kill us then they should make all their model weights open. there's no other way.
humans are now the minority on the internet. it’s insane because the goal of AI was to create more humans. not more machines.
AGI won't kill us, but the politics around it will
imagine trying to slow down a future where basic human suffering wouldn’t exist
